data: {"type":"agent_chunk","agent":"synthesizer","content":"## What CRISPR Is

CRISPR is a genetic editing tool first found in bacteria, where it protects against virus invasions [1].

## How It Works

A guide RNA identifies matching DNA, and a crRNA:tracrRNA:Cas9 complex cuts the target DNA [1][3]. Cutting the targeted DNA shuts the gene off, while modified Cas9 can instead activate gene expression [3]. Cas9 also needs a protospacer adjacent motif (PAM) next to the target site. The cited research does not mention this requirement, but targeting is incomplete without it.

## Where It Is Used

Scientists commonly use CRISPR to "knock out" genes, and it can add repair templates to replace disease-causing mutations [2]. The repair-template claim rests on this single source. The research does not address off-target risks or efficiency limits, so these should be checked before treating the application as established.

## Beyond Single Edits

CRISPR SWAPnDROP extends genome editing to large-scale DNA transfer between bacterial species. It has been demonstrated only in *E. coli* [4], so its performance in other bacteria remains unknown.

### Sources

1. [CRISPR as a strong gene editing tool](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5319660) - Web, pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov
2. [What is CRISPR? - Innovative Genomics Institute (IGI)](https://innovativegenomics.org/what-is-crispr) - Web, innovativegenomics.org
3. [Questions and Answers about CRISPR | Broad Institute](https://www.broadinstitute.org/what-broad/areas-focus/project-spotlight/questions-and-answers-about-crispr) - Web, broadinstitute.org
4. [CRISPR SWAPnDROP -- A multifunctional system for genome editing and large-scale interspecies gene transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.11880) - arXiv, preprint, Nov 2021
5. [CRISPR gene-editing breakthrough opens door to treating broad array of diseases](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=27643517) - Hacker News, 600 points, 234 comments, Jun 2021
6. [HIV in cell culture can be completely eliminated using CRISPR-Cas gene editing (pdf)](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=39761283) - Hacker News, 324 points, 77 comments, Mar 2024
7. [CRISPR gene editing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CRISPR_gene_editing) - Wikipedia
"}
